query:
SELECT m.sponsorId, s.companyName, COUNT(m.id) as meetings, COUNT(DISTINCT m.attendeeId) as uniqueDelegates
FROM meetings m
JOIN sponsors s ON s.id = m.sponsorId
GROUP BY m.sponsorId, s.companyName;
